title: MigrateMsg
description:
This structure describes a migration message.

Used for the ZIGchain `uzig`->`azig` redenomination: the chain rescales bank balances but not contract state, so each pool must have the native denom in its stored `asset_infos` rewritten from `denom_from` to `denom_to`. The migrate also resets the pool's TWAP accumulator (the reserve-ratio scale changes across a decimals change). A pool whose `asset_infos` contains no `denom_from` is left untouched (0 rewrites, TWAP preserved).

denom_from.description: The native denom to rewrite from (e.g. `uzig`)

denom_to.description: The native denom to rewrite to (e.g. `azig`)
